===== dist/pkg/api/core/config-service.d.ts =====
import { default as defaultConfig } from '../../config.json';
import { IHost } from '../features/host';

export { defaultConfig };
export declare type AdsConfig = {
    isEnabled: boolean;
    gameIdChanged: boolean;
    adTypes?: string[];
    cooldown?: number;
};
declare type LifecycleEventConfig = {
    gamesBlacklist: string[];
};
interface ConfigSchema {
    host: {
        supportsSubscriptions: string[];
    };
    nakama: {
        isEnabled: boolean;
        envs: string[];
        debugMode: boolean;
    };
    config: {
        refreshInterval: number;
    };
    lifecycle: Record<string, LifecycleEventConfig>;
    ads: {
        isEnabled: boolean;
        configs: Array<{
            conditions: string;
            config: {
                adTypes: string[];
                isEnabled: boolean;
                cooldown?: never;
            } | {
                adTypes: string[];
                isEnabled?: never;
                cooldown: number;
            };
        }>;
    };
}
export declare const schema: {
    type: string;
    properties: {
        host: {
            type: string;
            properties: {
                supportsSubscriptions: {
                    type: string;
                    items: {
                        type: string;
                    };
                };
            };
            required: string[];
            additionalProperties: boolean;
        };
        nakama: {
            type: string;
            properties: {
                isEnabled: {
                    type: string;
                };
                envs: {
                    type: string;
                    items: {
                        type: string;
                    };
                };
                debugMode: {
                    type: string;
                };
            };
            required: string[];
            additionalProperties: boolean;
        };
        config: {
            type: string;
            properties: {
                refreshInterval: {
                    type: string;
                };
            };
            required: string[];
            additionalProperties: boolean;
        };
        lifecycle: {
            type: string;
            patternProperties: {
                ".*": {
                    type: string;
                    properties: {
                        gamesBlacklist: {
                            type: string;
                            items: {
                                type: string;
                            };
                        };
                    };
                    required: string[];
                    additionalProperties: boolean;
                };
            };
            additionalProperties: boolean;
        };
        ads: {
            type: string;
            properties: {
                isEnabled: {
                    type: string;
                };
                configs: {
                    type: string;
                    items: {
                        type: string;
                        properties: {
                            conditions: {
                                type: string;
                            };
                            config: {
                                type: string;
                                oneOf: ({
                                    required: string[];
                                    properties: {
                                        adTypes: {
                                            type: string;
                                            items: {
                                                type: string;
                                            };
                                        };
                                        isEnabled: {
                                            type: string;
                                        };
                                        cooldown: boolean;
                                    };
                                    additionalProperties: boolean;
                                } | {
                                    required: string[];
                                    properties: {
                                        adTypes: {
                                            type: string;
                                            items: {
                                                type: string;
                                            };
                                        };
                                        isEnabled: boolean;
                                        cooldown: {
                                            type: string;
                                        };
                                    };
                                    additionalProperties: boolean;
                                })[];
                            };
                        };
                        required: string[];
                        additionalProperties: boolean;
                    };
                };
            };
            required: string[];
            additionalProperties: boolean;
        };
    };
    required: string[];
    additionalProperties: boolean;
};
declare type ConfigChangeCallback = (config: ConfigSchema) => void;
export declare class ConfigService {
    private _validate;
    private _config;
    private static _instance;
    private _isLoaded;
    private _refreshTimer;
    private _configChangeCallbacks;
    private _gameId;
    private _platformId;
    private _platformType;
    private _host;
    private _gameConfig;
    private constructor();
    static get Instance(): ConfigService;
    subscribe(callback: ConfigChangeCallback): () => void;
    private notifyConfigChange;
    init(host?: IHost): Promise<void>;
    loadConfig(): Promise<void>;
    get config(): ConfigSchema;
    dispose(): void;
    getConfigForProperty(property: string): any;
    private tokenize;
    private parseExpression;
    private evaluateAST;
    private evaluateCondition;
    private isDebugMode;
    private isPlatform;
    private isPlatformType;
    private isGame;
    setGameConfig(gameConfig: any): void;
    getGameConfigProperty(property: string, defaultValue?: any): any;
}

===== dist/pkg/api/core/debug-provider.d.ts =====
import { ObserverFn } from '../utils/observable';

export interface DebugProvider {
    isDebugMode?(): boolean;
    setDebugMode?(isEnabled: boolean): void;
    sendDebugEvent(type: string, ...args: any[]): void;
    onDebugEvent?(observer: any): void;
}
export declare function isDebugMode(): boolean;
export declare class DebugProviderArena implements DebugProvider {
    private static _instance;
    private observers;
    private isDebug;
    private constructor();
    static get Instance(): DebugProviderArena;
    private initDebugMode;
    isDebugMode(): boolean;
    setDebugMode(isEnabled: boolean): void;
    sendDebugEvent(type: string, ...args: any[]): void;
    onDebugEvent(observer: ObserverFn<string>): void;
}
export declare class DebugProviderGame implements DebugProvider {
    private static _instance;
    private constructor();
    static get Instance(): DebugProviderGame;
    sendDebugEvent(type: string, ...args: any[]): void;
}

===== dist/pkg/api/core/rpc.d.ts =====
declare type RpcRequest = {
    module: string;
    func: string;
    payload: any[];
    executionTimeLimitMs?: number;
};
export declare const EXECUTION_TIME_NO_LIMIT = -1;
declare class RpcPublisher {
    private rpcCallbacks;
    private target;
    private eventListener;
    init(target: any): void;
    sendMessage(message: RpcRequest): Promise<any>;
    unsubscribe(): void;
    private genId;
    private processMessages;
    private registerCb;
    private unregisterCB;
}
declare class RpcSubscriber {
    private eventListener;
    constructor();
    private registry;
    private target;
    init(target: any): void;
    addToRegistry(module: string, name: string, bindTo: any, fn: any): void;
    unsubscribe(): void;
    private getId;
    private processMessages;
    private sendResponse;
    private sendError;
}
export declare function shouldSubscribe(name: string, value: any): boolean;
/** @hidden */
export declare class RpcProvider {
    private static _instance;
    rpcPublisher: RpcPublisher;
    rpcSubscriber: RpcSubscriber;
    private constructor();
    static get Instance(): RpcProvider;
}
export {};

===== dist/pkg/api/features/ads/index.d.ts =====
import { RpcProvider } from '../../core/rpc';
import { ApiEnv } from '../backend/backend.api';
import { Auth } from '../auth/';
import { VideoAdOptions } from './video-ad';
import { BannerAdOptions, AdTypes } from './display-ad';
import { GameLifecycleArena, GameLifecycleGame } from '../game-lifecycle/game-lifecycle.api';
import { IHost } from '../host';

export declare type ShowInterstitialAdOptions = {
    duration?: number;
};
export declare type ShowRewardAdOptions = {
    duration?: number;
    context?: 'core' | 'default';
    data?: any;
};
/** @hidden */
export interface AdsArena extends Ads, AdsArenaBanner {
}
export interface AdsGame extends Ads, AdsGameBanner {
}
interface Ads {
    showPrerollAd?(options: VideoAdOptions): Promise<void>;
    showInterstitialAd(options: VideoAdOptions): Promise<void>;
    showRewardAd(options: VideoAdOptions): Promise<{
        value: number;
    }>;
}
interface AdsArenaBanner {
    showBannerAd?(options: BannerAdOptions): any;
}
interface AdsGameBanner {
    showBannerAd?(adId: string, dimensions: AdTypes[]): any;
}
/** @hidden */
export declare class AdsArenaProvider implements AdsArena {
    private host;
    bannerSizes: typeof AdTypes;
    private interstitial;
    private rewarded;
    private preroll;
    private banner;
    constructor(rpcProvider: RpcProvider, auth: Auth, lifecycle: GameLifecycleArena, host: IHost);
    private setAdErrorHandlingMode;
    setVideoAdsUrl(url: string): void;
    setVideoAdsDomain(domain: string): void;
    setDisplayAdsUrl(url: string): void;
    setDisplayAdsDomain(domain: string): void;
    showPrerollAd(options: VideoAdOptions): Promise<void>;
    showInterstitialAd(options: VideoAdOptions): Promise<void>;
    showRewardAd(options: VideoAdOptions): Promise<{
        value: number;
    }>;
    showBannerAd(options: BannerAdOptions): any;
}
export declare class AdsGameProvider implements AdsGame {
    private readonly lifecycle;
    readonly bannerSizes: typeof AdTypes;
    private readonly interstitial;
    private readonly rewarded;
    private readonly banner;
    constructor(rpcProvider: RpcProvider, env: ApiEnv, auth: Auth, lifecycle: GameLifecycleGame);
    showInterstitialAd({ duration }?: ShowInterstitialAdOptions): Promise<void>;
    showRewardAd({ duration, context, data }?: ShowRewardAdOptions): Promise<{
        value: number;
    }>;
    showBannerAd(adId: string, dimensions: AdTypes[]): Promise<void>;
}
export {};

===== dist/pkg/api/features/analytics/analytics.api.d.ts =====
import { RpcProvider } from '../../core/rpc';
import { AnalyticsProviderType, IAnalyticConfig } from './defs';
import { DimensionsObject, Dimension } from './dimensions';
import { IHost } from '../host';
import { DebugProvider } from '../../core/debug-provider';
import { ApiEnv } from '../backend/backend.api';

interface EnvironmentVersion {
    GameKey: string;
    GameVersion: string;
    NestVersion: string;
    SdkVersion: string;
}
declare type FingerprintData = {
    [Dimension.fpVisitorId]: string;
    [Dimension.fpIncognito]: string;
};
export interface AnalyticsApiContract {
    setGameVersion(v: string): Promise<void>;
    setNestVersion(v: string): Promise<void>;
    getEnvVersion(): Promise<EnvironmentVersion>;
    configureProvider(config: IAnalyticConfig): Promise<void>;
    sendEvent(eventCategory: string, eventAction: string, dimensions: DimensionsObject): Promise<void>;
    sendPageView(pageName: string, dimensions: DimensionsObject): Promise<void>;
    trackException(exception: Error): Promise<void>;
    clearProviders(): void;
}
/** @hidden */
export declare class AnalyticsApi implements AnalyticsApiContract {
    private host;
    private rpcProvider;
    private debugProvider;
    private arenaEnvironment;
    private providers;
    private configuredProviders;
    private disabledProviders;
    private info;
    providersTypes: typeof AnalyticsProviderType;
    constructor(host: IHost, rpcProvider: RpcProvider, debugProvider: DebugProvider, arenaEnvironment: ApiEnv);
    getEnvVersion(): Promise<EnvironmentVersion>;
    setGameVersion(v: string): Promise<void>;
    setNestVersion(v: string): Promise<void>;
    sendGameSDKInitEvent(version: string): Promise<void>;
    configureProvider(config: IAnalyticConfig): Promise<void>;
    sendEvent(eventCategory: string, eventAction: string, dimensions: DimensionsObject): Promise<void>;
    sendPageView(pageName: string, dimensions: DimensionsObject): Promise<void>;
    trackException(error: Error): Promise<void>;
    setFingerprintData(fingerprintData: FingerprintData): Promise<any>;
    enableProvider(providerType: AnalyticsProviderType): void;
    disableProvider(providerType: AnalyticsProviderType): void;
    clearProviders(): void;
}
export declare class AnalyticsApiProxy implements AnalyticsApiContract {
    private rpcProvider;
    CONSOLE: AnalyticsProviderType;
    APP_INSIGHTS: AnalyticsProviderType;
    GOOGLE: AnalyticsProviderType;
    private dimensionValues;
    private fingerprintData;
    constructor(rpcProvider: RpcProvider);
    getFingerprintVisitorId(): string;
    private setFingerprintData;
    setGameVersion(v: string): Promise<void>;
    setNestVersion(v: string): Promise<void>;
    getEnvVersion(): Promise<EnvironmentVersion>;
    configureProvider(config: IAnalyticConfig): Promise<void>;
    /**
     * Low level method to report an analytics event
     * Likely you can use the helper methods for common events instead.
     * @param eventCategory {Event}
     * @param eventAction optional action. values depend on the event category
     * @param dimensions record with dimensions to report
     */
    sendEvent(eventCategory: string, eventAction: string, dimensions: DimensionsObject): Promise<void>;
    /**
     * Low level method to report a page view
     * Likely you can use the helper methods for common page views instead.
     * @param pageName  the page name to report
     * @param dimensions record with dimensions to report
     */
    sendPageView(pageName: string, dimensions: DimensionsObject): Promise<void>;
    /**
     * Use this method to report an exception back to analytics
     * @param exception {Error} error to capture
     */
    trackException(exception: Error): Promise<void>;
    setDimensions(dimensions: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * Start of the Game (after preroll ends)
     */
    sendAppStartedEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * Loading ended, user can see Start button (after preroll ends)
     */
    sendMainScreenReadyEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * actions:
     * User clicked on Start Button [action 'Loaded' if user continued previous game, otherwise New]
     */
    sendStartButtonClickedEvent(action: 'New' | 'Loaded', dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * User sees gameplay and are ready to make action
     */
    sendGameplayReadyEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * User made first move (any click on the page)
     */
    sendFirstMoveEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * User entered the first right answer (for word games or trivia games and other applicable games)
     */
    sendFirstRightAnswerEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * @deprecated
     * User made first match (for match-3, mahjongg and other applicable games)
     */
    sendFirsMatchEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * User made first match (for match-3, mahjongg and other applicable games)
     */
    sendFirstMatchEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * @deprecated
     * User made first shot (for shooters and other applicable games)
     */
    sendFirsShotEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * User made first shot (for shooters and other applicable games)
     */
    sendFirstShotEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * Users started new Round (Level). First round is Round 1 (not 0) (applicable for games with evergreen logic, not infinite games - before Nest changes to gameplay)
     */
    sendRoundEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * actions:
     * - Finished - User successfully finished the Round (Level). First round is Round 1 (not 0) (applicable for games with evergreen logic, not infinite games - before Nest changes to gameplay)
     * - Not_Finished - User didn't finish the Round (Level) successfully OR leaves the game OR skips the round OR Quit (applicable for games with evergreen logic, not infinite games - before Nest changes to gameplay. If possible several lose scenarios, add reason dimension)
     *
     * dimensions:
     * - reason: No_Moves | Time_Out
     */
    sendRoundEndEvent(action: 'Finished' | 'Not_Finished', dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * actions:
     *
     * Win - User ended game because he wins (Round in Label only if game has it) (applicable for games with evergreen logic, not infinite games - before Nest changes to gameplay)
     * Lose -User ended game because he loses or faces "No More Moves' situation (Round in Label only if game has it) (applicable for games with evergreen logic, not infinite games - before Nest changes to gameplay)
     * Time_Out - User ended game because he runs of time (Round in Label only if game has it) (applicable for games with evergreen logic, not infinite games - before Nest changes to gameplay)
     * New_Game - User ends game because he starts a new game: click on 'New Game', then click on 'Yes' (Round in Label only if game has it) (applicable for games with evergreen logic, not infinite games - before Nest changes to gameplay)
     * Quit - User ends game because he quits a new game: click on 'Quit', then click on 'Yes' (Round in Label only if game has it) (applicable for games with evergreen logic, not infinite games - before Nest changes to gameplay)
     * Restart - User starts the same game from the beginning again (mostly for Solitaire games): click on 'Restart', then click on 'Yes' (Round in Label only if game has it) (applicable for games with evergreen logic, not infinite games - before Nest changes to gameplay)
     */
    sendGameEndEvent(action: 'Win' | 'Lose' | 'Time_Out' | 'New_Game' | 'Quit' | 'Restart', dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * User clicked on Reshuffle (for mahjonggs and other applicable games)
     */
    sendReshuffleEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * User meet any type of errors
     *
     * expected dimensions:
     * - reason
     */
    sendErrorEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * Users comes back from menu and sees the same game session [in games with limited gameplay time only]
     */
    sendGameScreenActionsEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * User turned sound on/off [for games where sound is a bar, and can be customized (e.g. 1/3 of max) - before Nest]
     * User turned music on/off [for games where music is a bar, and can be customized to specific position (e.g. 1/3 of max)- before Nest]
     */
    sendMenuActionsEvent(action: 'Sound_On' | 'Sound_Off' | 'Music_On' | 'Music_Off', dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * User turned sound on/off [for games where only on/off option is available - after Nest]
     */
    sendSettingsEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * Clicks on Help button on Game_Screen or in the menu
     */
    sendHelpEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * User saw  the help pop up [if it appeared once per gameplay]
     */
    sendHelpShownEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * User clicks on different button  in help menu [if it appeared once per gameplay]
     */
    sendHelpPageEvent(action: 'Next' | 'Prev', dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * Impression of FUE - tutorial [aplicable for multiple stages tutorial which appear in different places]
     */
    sendFUEEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * User saw a sign in pop up (before Nest, sent by game. Should be missed if Nest implemented.)
     * User logged in successfully  (before Nest, sent by game. Should be missed if Nest implemented.)
     */
    sendSignInPopUpEvent(action: 'Proposed' | 'Success', dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * User saw a sign in pop up (after Nest, sent by Nest. Should be missed if Nest not implemented.)
     */
    sendSignInClickedEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * User logged in successfully (returns with eagle id) (after Nest, sent by Nest. Should be missed if Nest not implemented.)
     */
    sendSignInSucceededEvent(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * 1st page = page with start button
     */
    sendIntroScreenPageView(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * Next page after user clicks on Start
     */
    sendGameScreenPageView(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * Game over page == every game end, except Quit
     */
    sendGameOverPageView(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    /**
     * When player manually quits the game
     */
    sendQuitConfirmedPageView(dimensions?: DimensionsObject): void;
    clearProviders(): void;
}
export {};

===== dist/pkg/api/features/analytics/defs.d.ts =====
export declare enum AnalyticsProviderType {
    CONSOLE = 1,
    GOOGLE = 2,
    APP_INSIGHTS = 3,
    APP_INSIGHTS_SDK = 300,
    ALL = 1000
}
export interface IAnalyticConfig {
    appId: string;
    provider: AnalyticsProviderType;
    providerConfig?: any;
}

===== dist/pkg/api/features/analytics/dimensions.d.ts =====
/**
 * Reference page:
 * https://arkadium.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DepartmentBusinessOperations/pages/23675756/Standardized+Spec+for+every+game+-+GA+AppInsights
 */
export declare type DimensionsObject = {
    [key: string]: any;
};
export declare enum Dimension {
    action = "action",
    /**
     * If game has infinite process, use Level dimensions
     */
    round = "round",
    /**
     *
     */
    score = "score",
    /**
     *
     */
    reason = "reason",
    /**
     * Domain, can be affected by iframe
     */
    domain = "domain",
    /**
     * getArenaName()
     */
    trafficSource = "trafficSource",
    /**
     * in seconds
     * where 0 is Level Start|Round Start - should show at that moment from start each event happened
     */
    timespent = "timespent",
    /**
     *
     */
    gameVersion = "gameVersion",
    /**
     * If applicable, when test is running
     */

===== dist/pkg/api/features/analytics/providers/AnalyticsProvider.d.ts =====
import { DimensionsObject } from '../dimensions';
import { IAnalyticConfig } from '../defs';

declare type EventArr = [string, string, DimensionsObject];
declare type PageViewArr = [string, DimensionsObject];
export declare abstract class AnalyticsProvider {
    protected config: IAnalyticConfig;
    private isReady;
    protected unsentEvents: EventArr[];
    protected unsentPageViews: PageViewArr[];
    protected unsentExceptions: Error[];
    constructor(config: IAnalyticConfig);
    protected setup(): Promise<void>;
    protected handleUnsent(): void;
    sendEvent(eventCategory: string, eventAction: string, dimensions: DimensionsObject): void;
    sendPageView(pageName: string, dimensions: DimensionsObject): void;
    trackException(exception: Error): void;
    protected abstract getProviderName(): string;
    protected abstract sendEventImpl(eventCategory: string, eventAction: string, dimensions: DimensionsObject): void;
    protected abstract sendPageViewImpl(pageName: string, dimensions: DimensionsObject): void;
    protected abstract trackExceptionImpl(exception: Error): void;
    protected debugSendEvent(eventCategory: string, eventAction: string, dimensions: DimensionsObject): void;
    protected debugSendPageView(pageName: string, dimensions: DimensionsObject): void;
    protected debugTrackException(exception: Error): void;
    getProviderType(): import('../defs').AnalyticsProviderType;
}
export {};

===== dist/pkg/api/features/auth/index.d.ts =====
import { Backend } from '../backend/backend.api';
import { createStore } from '../../utils/observable';
import { RpcProvider } from '../../core/rpc';
import { IHost } from '../host';

interface Image {
    png: string;
    webp: string;
}
interface UserProfile {
    uid: string;
    username: string;
    avatar: Image;
    avatarFrame?: Image;
    avatarBackground?: string;
    isUserSubscriber: boolean;
    aarpMembershipStatus?: boolean;
    coins?: number;
    level?: number;
}
interface UserProfileReaderContract {
    authStatus: ReturnType<typeof createStore<boolean>>;
    isUserAuthorized(): Promise<boolean>;
    getUserProfile(): Promise<UserProfile | null>;
    init(): Promise<void>;
}
interface AuthUIManagerContract {
    openAuthRequest: ReturnType<typeof createStore<boolean>>;
    openAuthForm(): Promise<void>;
    closeAuthForm(): Promise<void>;
    onOpenAuthForm(observer: any): void;
}
export declare function getAvatarLink(avatarName: string, extension: string): string;
export declare abstract class Auth {
    private backendApi;
    protected userProfileReader: UserProfileReaderContract;
    protected authUIManager: AuthUIManagerContract | undefined;
    private userId?;
    constructor(backendApi: Backend, host: IHost);
    init(): Promise<void>;
    isUserAuthorized(): Promise<boolean>;
    getToken(): Promise<string | undefined>;
    abstract getUserProfile(): Promise<UserProfile | null>;
    onAuthStatusChange(observer: any): () => void;
    openAuthForm(): Promise<void>;
    closeAuthForm(): Promise<void>;
    onOpenAuthForm(observer: any): void | undefined;
    getUserId(): Promise<string | undefined>;
}
export declare class AuthArena extends Auth {
    constructor(backendApi: Backend, host: IHost, rpcProvider: RpcProvider);
    getUserProfile(): Promise<UserProfile | null>;
}
export declare class AuthGame extends Auth {
    private rpcProvider;
    constructor(backendApi: Backend, host: IHost, rpcProvider: RpcProvider);
    getUserProfile(): Promise<UserProfile | null>;
}
export {};

import { Presence } from '@heroiclabs/nakama-js';

};

    setAutoJoinChat(isEnabled: boolean): void;
    getJoinedChats(): ChatChannel[];
    getChatMessages({ chatId, fromCache, limit }: GetChatMessagesParams): Promise<ChatMessage[]>;
    joinDirectChat(userId: string): Promise<ChatChannel>;
    private joinChat;
    sendMessageWithFriendId(userId: string, data: object): Promise<void>;
    sendMessageWithChatId(chatId: string, data: object): Promise<void>;

    private addChatPresences;
    private addChatPresence;
    private addChatMessage;
    private addChatMessages;

import { NakamaProvider } from '../nakama/nakama-provider';
import { Auth } from '../auth/index';

import { NotificationsArena, NotificationListener } from '../notifications';

export declare const FRIEND_STATE_FRIENDS: number;
export declare const FRIEND_STATE_SENT_REQUEST: number;
export declare const FRIEND_STATE_RECEIVED_REQUEST: number;
export declare const FRIEND_STATE_BLOCKED: number;
export declare enum FriendshipState {
    None = "none",
    Friends = "friends",
    RequestSent = "request_sent",
    RequestReceived = "request_received",
    Blocked = "blocked"
}
export declare enum UserStatusType {
    Online = "online",
    Offline = "offline",
    InGame = "in_game",
    Custom = "custom"
}
export interface GameStatus {
    type: UserStatusType.InGame;
    gameId: string;
    gameName: string;
    customMessage?: string;
}
export interface CustomStatus {
    type: UserStatusType.Custom;
    message: string;
}
export interface BasicStatus {
    type: UserStatusType.Online | UserStatusType.Offline;
}
export declare type UserStatus = GameStatus | CustomStatus | BasicStatus;
declare type Friend = {
    avatarUrl?: string;
    displayName?: string;
    id?: string;
    online?: boolean;
    username?: string;
    friendshipState?: FriendshipState;
    status?: UserStatus;

    private compressUUID;
    private decompressUUID;
    getFriendlyId(): Promise<string>;
    getFriendlyIdWithEagleId(eagleId: any): string;
    sendFriendRequestWithFriendlyId(friendlyId: string): Promise<void>;
    sendFriendRequestWithUserId(userId: string): Promise<void>;
    private sendFriendRequest;
    acceptFriendRequest(friendId: string): Promise<void>;
    rejectFriendRequest(friendId: string): Promise<void>;
    cancelFriendRequest(friendId: string): Promise<void>;
    removeFriend(friendId: string): Promise<void>;
    getFriends(): Promise<Array<Friend>>;
    getOnlineFriends(): Promise<Array<Friend>>;
    isFriend(userId: string): Promise<boolean>;
    private followFriends;
    private unfollowFriends;
    private onStatusPresenceChanged;
    protected onSocketConnectionChanged(isConnected: boolean): void;
    subscribeFriendRequestNotificationListener(listener: NotificationListener): void;
    subscribeFriendRequestAcceptedNotificationListener(listener: NotificationListener): void;
    subscribeFriendsOnlineListener(listener: (onlineFriends: Array<Friend>) => void): void;
    subscribeFriendsJoinedListener(listener: (joinedFriends: Array<Friend>) => void): void;
    subscribeFriendsLeftListener(listener: (leftFriends: Array<Friend>) => void): void;
    blockFriend(friendId: string): Promise<boolean>;
    private updateFriendStatus;
    updateStatus(status?: UserStatus): Promise<void>;
    setOnlineStatus(): Promise<void>;
    setOfflineStatus(): Promise<void>;
    setGameStatus(gameId: string, gameName: string, customMessage?: string): Promise<void>;
    setCustomStatus(message: string): Promise<void>;

===== dist/pkg/api/utils/validate-input.d.ts =====
export declare type ValidationResult = {
    valid: true;
} | {
    valid: false;
    expected: string;
    received: string;
};
export declare type ArgumentValidator = (value: unknown) => ValidationResult;
/**
 * Schema primitives for defining object shapes. Use these as the single source of truth:
 * define the schema once, derive the type with InferSchema, and pass to schema() for validation.
 */
export declare type SchemaPrimitive = 'string' | 'number' | 'boolean' | 'object' | 'array';
/**
 * Infers a TypeScript type from a schema object. Use with: type T = InferSchema<typeof mySchema>
 */
export declare type InferSchema<T> = T extends Record<string, SchemaPrimitive> ? {
    [K in keyof T]: SchemaPrimitiveToType<T[K]>;
} : never;
declare type SchemaPrimitiveToType<P> = P extends 'string' ? string : P extends 'number' ? number : P extends 'boolean' ? boolean : P extends 'object' ? Record<string, unknown> : P extends 'array' ? unknown[] : never;
/**
 * Creates a validator from a schema object. The schema is the single source of truth:
 * use InferSchema<typeof schema> for the type and schema(schema) for the decorator.
 *
 * @example
 * const UrlStateSchema = { url: 'string' } as const;
 * type UrlState = InferSchema<typeof UrlStateSchema>;
 * @ValidateInput(schema(UrlStateSchema))
 * private updateUrlState(urlState: UrlState): void { ... }
 */
export declare function schema<T extends Record<string, SchemaPrimitive>>(shape: T): ArgumentValidator;
/**
 * Decorator that validates method arguments before invocation.
 * Pass one validator per argument in order.
 * Throws an Error with details about which argument(s) failed validation.
 *
 * @example
 * @ValidateInput(schema(UrlStateSchema))
 * private updateUrlState(urlState: UrlState): void { ... }
 */
export declare function ValidateInput(...validators: ArgumentValidator[]): (_target: unknown, propertyKey: string, descriptor: PropertyDescriptor) => PropertyDescriptor;
export {};

import { ApiEnv, Backend, SessionStorageType } from './api/features/backend/backend.api';

import { AdsArena } from './api/features/ads/';
import { AuthArena } from './api/features/auth/';

/** @hidden */
export declare class ArkadiumArenaSdk {
    backendApi: Backend;
    host: HostArena;
    lifecycle: GameLifecycleArena;
    ads: AdsArena;
    auth: AuthArena;
    analytics: AnalyticsApiContract;
    private timeoutTester;
    persistence: PersistenceArena;
    private wallet;
    debug: DebugProviderArena;
    private supportV1;
    private leaderboard;
    friends: FriendsArena;
    notifications: NotificationsArena;
    chats: ChatArena;
    ratings: RatingsArena;
    tournaments: TournamentsArena;
    recorder: RecorderArena;
    private currentEnv;
    private currentTarget;
    private gamePingSender;
    private gamePingListener;
    $pingNotification: Observable<number>;
    version: string;
    config: ConfigService;
    constructor(backendApi: Backend, host: HostArena, lifecycle: GameLifecycleArena, ads: AdsArena, auth: AuthArena, analytics: AnalyticsApiContract, timeoutTester: TimeoutTesterContract, persistence: PersistenceArena, wallet: WalletArena, debug: DebugProviderArena, supportV1: SupportV1, leaderboard: LeaderboardArena, friends: FriendsArena, notifications: NotificationsArena, chats: ChatArena, ratings: RatingsArena, tournaments: TournamentsArena, recorder: RecorderArena);
    setEnv(e: ApiEnv): void;
    initialize(env: ApiEnv, isGameSide: boolean, sessionStorage?: SessionStorageType | null): Promise<void>;
    private envDiscoverListener;
    updateWinReference(target: any): void;
    debugMode(isEnabled: boolean): void;
    ping(): Promise<any>;
    dispose(): void;
    setMockUserConfig({ isEnabled, mockUser }: {
        isEnabled: boolean;
        mockUser: MockUserUtils.MockUser;
    }): void;
}
export { ApiEnv };
/** @hidden */
export declare class ArenaApi {
    static version: string;
    static ApiEnv: typeof ApiEnv;
    private static sdk;
    static onGameSDKLoaded(target: any, callback: any, env?: ApiEnv): void;
    static dispose(): void;
    static getInstance(env: ApiEnv, deferInit?: boolean): Promise<ArkadiumArenaSdk>;
}

===== dist/pkg/arkadium-game-sdk.d.ts =====
import { ApiEnv, Backend } from './api/features/backend/backend.api';
import { GameLifecycleGame } from './api/features/game-lifecycle/game-lifecycle.api';
import { AdsGame } from './api/features/ads/';
import { AuthGame } from './api/features/auth/';
import { AnalyticsApiProxy } from './api/features/analytics/analytics.api';
import { RpcProvider } from './api/core/rpc';
import { TimeoutTesterContract } from './api/core/timeout-tester';
import { PersistenceGame } from './api/features/persistence';
import { Wallet, WalletGame } from './api/features/wallet';
import { HostGame } from './api/features/host';
import { LeaderboardGame } from './api/features/leaderboard';
import { TournamentsGame } from './api/features/tournaments';
import { RecorderGame } from './api/features/recorder';

export declare class ArkadiumGameSdk {
    version: string;
    private currentEnv;
    private arenaPingSender;
    private arenaPingListener;
    private rpcProvider;
    private backendApi;
    host: HostGame;
    lifecycle: GameLifecycleGame;
    ads: AdsGame;
    auth: AuthGame;
    analytics: AnalyticsApiProxy;
    private timeoutTester;
    persistence: PersistenceGame;
    wallet: Wallet;
    leaderboard: LeaderboardGame;
    tournaments: TournamentsGame;
    constructor({ rpcProvider, backendApi, host, lifecycle, ads, auth, analytics, timeoutTester, persistence, wallet, leaderboard, tournaments, recorder }: {
        rpcProvider: RpcProvider;
        backendApi: Backend;
        host: HostGame;
        lifecycle: GameLifecycleGame;
        ads: AdsGame;
        auth: AuthGame;
        analytics: AnalyticsApiProxy;
        timeoutTester: TimeoutTesterContract;
        persistence: PersistenceGame;
        wallet: WalletGame;
        leaderboard: LeaderboardGame;
        tournaments: TournamentsGame;
        recorder: RecorderGame;
    });
    initialize(env: ApiEnv, isGameSide: boolean): Promise<void>;
    getEnv(): ApiEnv;
    updateWinReference(target: any): void;
    debugMode(enabled: boolean): void;
}
export { ApiEnv };
export { Dimension } from './api/features/analytics/dimensions';
export { Event } from './api/features/analytics/events';
interface EnvDiscoverer {
    discover(): Promise<ApiEnv>;
}
export declare class GameApi {
    static version: string;
    private static sdk;
    private static envDiscoverer;
    static getInstance(): Promise<ArkadiumGameSdk>;
    static setEnvDiscoverer(d: EnvDiscoverer): void;
}

===== dist/pkg/loader.d.ts =====
import { ArkadiumGameSdk } from './arkadium-game-sdk';

declare type API = ArkadiumGameSdk;
export declare enum Env {
    DEV = "DEV",
    PROD = "PROD",
    STAGING = "STAGING"
}
export declare function getInstance(env?: Env): Promise<API>;
export {};
